STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_019083.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_019083.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_019083 (
    ID_opcode,
    ID_funct3,
    ID_rs,
    ID_rt,
    ID_is_equal,
    EX_rd,
    EX_rd_eff,
    ID_Imm,
    ID_PC,
    ID_PC4,  //modified for branch prediction
    ID_data1,
    in_branch_addr,  //modified for branch prediction
    ID_br_taken,  //
    out_miss,  //
    out_miss_addr,  //
    JumpBranch_addr,
    JumpBranch_jump,
    JumpBranch_stall,
    JumpBranch_flush,
    JumpBranch_link,
    JumpBranch_branch,
    JumpBranch_JALR
);

  //=====I/O Declaration===============

  input [6:0] ID_opcode;
  input [2:0] ID_funct3;
  input [4:0] ID_rs;
  input [4:0] ID_rt;
  input ID_is_equal;
  input [4:0] EX_rd;
  input EX_rd_eff;
  input [31:0] ID_Imm;
  input [31:0] ID_PC, ID_PC4;
  input [31:0] ID_data1;
  input [31:0] in_branch_addr;
  input ID_br_taken;
  output reg [31:0] out_miss_addr;
  output out_miss;
  output reg [31:0] JumpBranch_addr;
  output JumpBranch_jump;
  output JumpBranch_stall;
  output JumpBranch_flush;
  output JumpBranch_link;
  output JumpBranch_branch;
  output JumpBranch_JALR;
  wire BEQBNE_branch;
  wire BEQBNE_stall;
  wire BEQBNE_flush;
  wire JAL_flush;
  wire JALR_stall;
  wire JALR_flush;

  wire [31:0] JALR_Addr_Temp;

  wire ID_br_inv, ID_pred_wrong;

  //=====Combinational Part===========
  BEQBNE branch (
      .ID_opcode(ID_opcode),
      .ID_funct3(ID_funct3),
      .ID_is_equal(ID_is_equal),
      .ID_rs(ID_rs),
      .ID_rt(ID_rt),
      .EX_rd(EX_rd),
      .EX_rd_eff(EX_rd_eff),
      .BEQBNE_flush(BEQBNE_flush),  //do branch
      .BEQBNE_stall(BEQBNE_stall),
      .BEQBNE_branch(BEQBNE_branch)  //ins is branch
  );
  JAL jump (
      .ID_opcode(ID_opcode),
      .JAL_flush(JAL_flush)
  );
  JALR jumpreg (
      .ID_opcode(ID_opcode),
      .ID_rs(ID_rs),
      .EX_rd(EX_rd),
      .EX_rd_eff(EX_rd_eff),
      .JALR_stall(JALR_stall),
      .JALR_flush(JALR_flush)  //ins is JALR
  );

  //assign JumpBranch_flush = BEQBNE_flush | JAL_flush | JALR_flush;
  assign JumpBranch_flush = out_miss | JAL_flush | JALR_flush;
  //assign JumpBranch_jump = JumpBranch_flush;
  assign JumpBranch_jump = JAL_flush | JALR_flush;
  assign JumpBranch_stall = BEQBNE_stall | JALR_stall;
  assign JumpBranch_link = JAL_flush | JALR_flush;
  assign JumpBranch_branch = BEQBNE_branch;
  assign JumpBranch_JALR = JALR_flush;
  assign JALR_Addr_Temp = ID_data1 + ID_Imm;

  always @(*) begin
    if (JALR_flush) JumpBranch_addr = {JALR_Addr_Temp[31:1], 1'b0};
    else JumpBranch_addr = ID_Imm + ID_PC;
  end

  //branch prediction
  assign ID_br_inv     = ID_funct3[0];
  assign ID_pred_wrong = ^{ID_br_inv, ID_br_taken, ID_is_equal};
  assign out_miss      = JumpBranch_branch & ID_pred_wrong;
  always @(*) begin
    if (BEQBNE_flush) out_miss_addr = in_branch_addr;
    else out_miss_addr = ID_PC4;
  end

endmodule
